description: Put an existing HTTPS API behind x402 without changing its code: returns a paid URL that answers 402 with your price, forwards paid calls to your API, and settles each payment straight to your wallet. 1,000 paid calls a month free, then 1% from prepaid credits. Pass your key, or omit it and a new one is returned.

key.description: Your Neuronto key (nc_ or nk_). Omit to get one.

name.description: What buyers see, for example 'Weather API'.

price_usd.description: Price per call in US dollars, paid in USDC.
